question: What exact NSH execution and MPU primitives can bootstrap a custom module loader when stock insmod is absent?
prototype_hypothesis: exec parses a hexadecimal Thumb callable and invokes it as int (*)(int); MPU regions are allocated and configured by firmware helpers
callsite_evidence: The NSH command table entry whose usage points to <hex-address> has handler callable 0x0C0FE4FD.
Exact handler sub_C0FE4FC parses argv[1] as hexadecimal, prints Calling %p, and executes BLX through the parsed pointer without cache maintenance.
Because the handler leaves the print callback return value in r0, a bootstrap entry must tolerate one unspecified integer argument.

The NSH mw command table entry whose usage is <hex-address>[=<hex-value>] [<hex-byte-count>] has handler callable 0x0C102DF1; sub_C102DF0 performs volatile-sized 32-bit accesses in four-byte steps and performs no cache maintenance.
Startup copies the complete 0x22C4-byte SRAM text image into 0x20082D40..0x20085004 and immediately uses 0x20085004 as BSS start; this executable range has no unoccupied tail safe for a bootstrap.

sub_C51D8D0 allocates one of eight tracked MPU region IDs. sub_C51D758 configures a region after enforcing 32-byte base alignment and length >= 32. Stock SRAM text protection calls it with access_attr=1 and mem_attr=1. sub_C51D928 releases the tracked region ID.
control_flow_evidence: exec uses BLX, so the supplied address must be a Thumb callable with bit 0 set.
exec does not retain or supervise the called image; the bootstrap or loader must establish its own lifetime and return contract.
Dynamic executable memory requires explicit MPU-region ownership and instruction synchronization before control transfer.
ownership_analysis: A persistent loader must own every allocation and MPU region for as long as loaded code can execute, then run destructors and release both on unload. A one-shot bootstrap must transfer this ownership to the resident loader before returning.
unsafe_assumptions: No fixed writable RAM address has yet been proven both unused and executable for NSH mw injection.
No exact data-cache clean and instruction-cache invalidate ABI has yet been approved.
Stock insmod and rmmod are absent from this firmware and must not be advertised.
recommended_probe: Use a host-generated stage-0 only after proving a scratch allocation and cache/MPU transition; write it with mw, execute the odd callable address, and require a deterministic status word before loading any module.
